rows.question: How do I verify SSL certificates or turn verification off?
rows.answer: Requests verifies SSL certificates for HTTPS requests by default, throwing an SSLError if it cannot verify the certificate (docs/user/advanced.rst:211-244). To verify against a specific CA, pass verify the path to a CA_BUNDLE file or directory of trusted CAs, e.g. requests.get('https://github.com', verify='/path/to/certfile'), or set it persistently on a Session with s.verify = '/path/to/certfile' (docs/user/advanced.rst:211-244). You can also set the trusted CAs via the REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE environment variable, falling back to CURL_CA_BUNDLE (docs/user/advanced.rst:211-244). To turn verification off, set verify=False, e.g. requests.get('https://kennethreitz.org', verify=False); note this accepts any TLS certificate and ignores hostname mismatches and expired certificates, making the application vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks, so it is only recommended for local development or testing (docs/user/advanced.rst:243-252).
